feature_title: Consumer Graphify Query Infrastructure & Unified Agent Routing

zero_trust_path_boundary_confinement.details: All workspace and graph file paths strictly validated against root directory via ValidatePathBoundary with filepath.Clean and prefix checks.

subprocess_command_injection_defense.details: Discrete argv slice passing via exec.CommandContext; zero shell interpolation (sh -c, bash -c); metacharacters treated as literal data.

missing_graph_actionable_guidance.details: Pre-execution os.Stat check returns ErrGraphNotFound with friendly guidance ('Run gautama-graph first') before executing subprocesses or downloads.

resource_caps_and_timeout_bounds.details: 10MB stdout/stderr buffer caps in SubprocessRunner and default 30-second context cancellation timeouts prevent DoS and zombie process leaks.

memory_and_cgo_safety.details: Pure Go 1.26+ standard library implementation; zero CGo (0 occurrences), zero unsafe.Pointer (0 occurrences).

dependency_vulnerability_audit.details: Automated govulncheck scan completed with 0 known vulnerabilities across all dependencies.

deterministic_race_detection.details: 60 table-driven tests executed with go test -v -race with 0 data races; 87.4% coverage on internal/runner, 95.6% on internal/scaffold.
